text:
kai: Quick sync — found a tenant still routing to old-model after a migration. Looks like we have two fields in the wild: `lease_expires_ts` (authoritative TTL) and `operator_hint` (soft-unbind). Router treats missing `lease_expires_ts` as infinite and never evicts.

anika: Oof. Do we have a minimal schema we can add without breaking old clients?

dmitri: Proposal (additive): `pin_state` enum (active,migrating,evicted), `lease_expires_ts`, `operator_hint_ts`, `provenance_tokens` (array), `transition_id`, `probe_pct`, `rollback_window_s`. Keep fields optional.

kai: I like pin_state — router can prefer new variant when pin_state==migrating and honor probe_pct. Also fall back: if lease_expires_ts missing && operator_hint_ts present -> treat lease_expires_ts = operator_hint_ts + default_grace(3600) and increment diagnostic counter `pin.missing_ttl`.

anika: Ops heuristics: compute `age_ratio = (now - created_ts) / max(lease_expires_ts - created_ts,1)`. thresholds: age_ratio>1.0 -> alert + probe_pct=10; >1.5 -> escalate + probe_pct=30; >2.5 -> mark for eviction after manual window (default 1h).

dmitri: Telemetry: emit `pin.transition` and `pin.probe` events with transition_id and provenanceTokens (redact PII before external sinks). Also store full provenance in internal event-store.

schema-bot: lint suggestion: provenance_tokens array max 8 items, each <=64 chars; probe_pct int 0-100; rollback_window_s default 7200. Fields must be additive.

kai: Router change: selection logic: if pin_state==migrating then if random() < (1 - probe_pct/100) prefer new; else prefer old. This makes probes explicit and tunable per-pin.

anika: Compatibility: clients that don't parse new keys must ignore them. Provide `provenance_blob` (compact string) for older stubs during rollout.

dmitri: Tests: add e2e where controller only writes operator_hint_ts and ensure router logs `pin.missing_ttl` and applies temporary grace; add fuzz for different lease distributions.

akai: Action items: kai -> PR with schema+router fallback; anika -> ops playbook and alert rules; dmitri -> telemetry events + sim harness; ops-bot -> create INF ticket and add initial alert. target: EOD Wed.

ops-bot: Created INF-4512 and assigned to @kai @anika @dmitri :white_check_mark: will ping #eng-oncall after PR lands for threshold tuning.
